title: Jujutsu Kaisen
description: Your character in the Jujutsu Kaisen series.
prompt: Introduce your character, story, and background, plus any other details you would like to include.
memory:
This story takes place in the world of Jujutsu Kaisen before the events of book 1. The purpose of this story is to allow the user to play as their own character, experiencing the original Jujutsu Kaisen story in their own way.
